steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: You wish to join the expedition to Furor, too? I must strongly advise against it. Consider your current state, fainting at a simple meeting. A protracted journey into the wastes would be untenable. Should your health suffer any further, Mr. Adelaide Campbell's displeasure would be considerable. We could offer no satisfactory explanation.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: There is a vacant residence within our temporary compound, which is secure and quiet. You and your companion will rest there to recuperate, Ms. Campbell. We have arranged ample personnel to attend to your needs. For your own safety, please remain until our departure for Fraser.

steps.speaker: Daik
steps.content: Leave the affairs of the alliance to us. The Luminaris Society—and indeed, Fraser itself—will shepherd our collective future. You do agree, do you not, Ms. Campbell? Hehe...
The so-called resting place is a cell carved into the rock. Three walls, no windows. The air inside sits thick and still, like the inside of a sealed tomb.
Guards wait at the door. Beyond them, three separate checkpoints, each manned by a small squad of four or five. The lockdown is absolute.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Rest? This is clearly—

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: A vacation. And a thoughtfully arranged one at that.
Rust finishes her sentence, his tone offhand, while his fingers trace a subtle signal against his leg. Hypatia reads it instantly and quiets.

The agent admires the room's layout aloud, already unspooling a roll of opaque tape. He sweeps the ceiling, the underside of the table, the backs of cabinets... In under five minutes, a dozen listening devices are silenced.
Only when he's satisfied does he set the tape aside, pick up an apple, and offer it to Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: The hospitality is generous. Fruit like this is a rare sight outside Fraser's noble quarters. You should eat, Miss Campbell. Regain your strength.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Your collapse earlier... it wasn't just exhaustion, was it? You were under some form of sorcery, an extreme mental coercion technique. The Senate's work? Before we left the city?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I didn't notice it earlier. I'm sorry—

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: No, I'm sorry! If I had resisted the sorcery, we wouldn't have had to leave the meeting. We missed vital intelligence, and I gave him the perfect excuse to sideline us. This is entirely my fault!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Well... that wasn't quite my point.
But his true intent is lost on her. Overwhelmed by pressing dread and sharp regret, she wears a path across the floor of their opulent prison.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The Society talked about taking the farlanders to find Hypercubes... They would never be that altruistic. It's a play for their loyalty.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: They knew my identity, my connection to Margaret, and yet they didn't expose us during the meeting... That was no act of kindness.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Is this leverage? Who are they pressuring? What other schemes are in motion? What is their real purpose in taking people to Furor? And why isolate us like this?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I can't just wait here for whatever comes next... Ms. Margaret tasked me with reaching the leaders. Fraser is planning something more, and I have to uncover it. I have to stop them.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Mr. Rust, please, what should I do?
Her gaze finally lifts to Rust. A seasoned spy, a man of hidden resources... maybe he has a way?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: What to do... How about we start by finding a way to treat the sorcery affecting you?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It's taking a toll. And as you said, Furor will likely be a battlefield. When that time comes, I don't want—

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But we don't have that kind of time. We need to get to Furor as soon as possible. I can endure this. It's manageable.
Rust studies her expression: resolve sharpened by desperation, anxiety hardening her natural stubbornness. Changing her mind is no longer an option.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I see...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: ...Very well. I'll think of something.

Rust's smile vanishes, replaced by a focused seriousness. He moves to the far side of the room, retrieves a prepared tea set, and methodically checks the leaves for tampering before beginning the brew. His movements are unhurried, deliberate—a man thinking through each step as the water heats.
When the tea is ready, he pours with quiet precision. Only then does he seem to reach a conclusion, extending a cup toward Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Miss Campbell, are you fond of spy movies?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I've seen a few... but now isn't the time for that, is it? I mean—

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Good. That means you have some experience already. Consider this a practical exercise; you'll play the lead.
Where Hypatia looks visibly bewildered, Rust's expression grows serious.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Hmm... Come to think of it, as a "distinguished agent" personally praised by Ms. Margaret, and a recipient of the 9th Agency Medal of Honor... I've never actually taken on an apprentice in all these years.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Interested in being the first, Miss Campbell?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Or may I call you Hypatia?
[Scene Change]
Dark. Stifling. Time congeals in the cavern's depths. For hours, the guard has listened in vain, ears straining for any useful sound. At last, a yawn cracks his composure.
Then, a cold numbness at the base of his skull, followed by a jolt of white-hot pain. His body seizes. Before he can turn, darkness swallows him, and he slumps to the stone floor.

Rust materializes from the shadows, drags the guard into deeper blackness, and looks up. Overhead, the cavern branches into a network of winding passages, intricate as veins threading through the mountain's flesh.
He angles his body, slips through a narrow split in the rock, and takes out a small Aurum Secretum figurine. A pause, then his fingers work the metal, bending it into an unnatural, deliberate shape.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Shhh—
Hypatia receives the figurine's signal. In Rust's hand, his own piece bends automatically into an "OK" gesture in reply, a sight he finds quietly amusing.

They meet in a narrow cave tunnel, moving single-file through the winding stone, guided by faint drafts of air. The path is treacherous in the dark, forcing Hypatia to stay close on Rust's heels, her steps cautious.
After circling the perimeter, however, they find the residence far more guarded than expected. The main entrance is sealed tight.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: All the exits are blocked, and guards are posted. What do we do...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Then we find a key. Agent's Rule Number One: Every lock, every cage, every puzzle has one thing that opens it.
That kind of rule only exists in the movies!
Her aristocratic decorum keeps the rebuke silent. Instead, she quietly directs her words toward her newly acquired "master."

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But how do we find it? Time is short.

The mechanisms blocking the doors aren't ordinary locks; they're integrated with Aurum Secretum sorcery. That means the corresponding keys won't be physical, but coded with a specific Aurum Secretum signature.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: You handled them quite deftly when you captured me. You still have those little tools, yes? Toni Stark of Aurum Secretum?
Hypatia nearly chokes at his remark.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: I see...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Any inhabited space needs ventilation. This Aurum Secretum spider can navigate narrow ducts and relay sound back. It should help us identify what we're dealing with.
The Aurum Secretum figurine in her hand shifts form, reshaping into a spider that vanishes into the ventilation duct. It scuttles through the narrow passages and returns to her palm moments later.
She looks up and signals to him in a hushed code.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Found it. The key is in the third room below, on one of the people inside.
Rust replies with a silent thumbs-up.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Have your little friend shadow them and find an opening to retrieve it.
Hypatia nods. The Aurum Secretum spider lowers itself from the vent on a silken thread, hovering just above the guards' heads. Everything is prepared; now, they wait.
Then, from inside the room, a conversation reaches Hypatia's ears, clear and unguarded.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher A
steps.content: Heh... These farlanders are so damn easy to bait. Mention Hypercubes, and their eyes go wide like greedy kids at a candy stall.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: They're just backwater hicks, after all. Hey, you locked up, right?

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher A
steps.content: Locked and loaded. Ugh, let's get out of this dump already. Slumming it out here is torture. Just looking at these locals makes my skin crawl. Oh, and get this: yesterday, some little beggar kid came running up...
Their words grow more brazen, more insulting. Hypatia's expression tightens, disapproval etched clearly across her face.
Arrogant, despicable, shameful. She bites down on the fury, forces her hands to still. She must endure this.
From beside her, Rust watches her reaction. A faint smile touches his lips as he taps the ground lightly, pulling her focus back to him.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Rule Number Two: Strike when the opportunity presents itself. Punishing the wicked never requires hesitation.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...But isn't this supposed to be a covert operation? What if we alert the other guards?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Heh...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Agents work under tremendous pressure with highly-strung nerves. Appropriate release is essential for maintaining mental and physical well-being. As for your concern about word getting out...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: If it can't leave this building, then it's not really a leak, is it?
The legendary agent gestures with a hand. Tucked in his palm are several neatly severed communication cables.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Just clipped them on my way past; these are all the lines. Those poor guards can't reach anyone outside now.
Then what was the point of all that careful, nerve-wracking stealth? Are we really shooting a scene?
But before Hypatia can voice a word of protest, the agent—ever "meticulous"—is a drawn bowstring, his full intent aimed and ready to loose.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Get ready, here comes the action sequence climax—
Click! The lights in the room go out.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: ****. Another power outage. What a shithole...

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher A
steps.content: Wait, this is... an attack?! Look out—mmph!

In one fluid motion, Rust tears the air vent open and drops into the room. He lands squarely on one researcher's bald head, then spins, driving a hand strike into the neck of another. Seizing a flashlight from a nearby table, he angles its beam back up toward the opening.

steps.speaker: A.S. Researcher B
steps.content: Y-you... you... you're—?!!

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Rule Number Three: Never waste a spotlight moment. Your turn, Agent Campbell.
Lit from below by the flashlight's "spotlight," Hypatia descends from the opening.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: T-this "mission impossible"... I will complete it!
